title: asperula oligantha var. gunnii
intro: Asperula oligantha var. gunnii, commonly known as Wild Sweet Woodruff, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Rubiaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is believed to provide relief from anxiety, insomnia, and restlessness due to its calming effects. The health benefits of Asperula oligantha var. gunnii include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help soothe digestive issues and promote overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoids, which contribute to its sedative, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
